steady_timing_claim_gate: All five workloads and both tasks must improve median complete-model forward and forward+backward time by at least 5% in the fresh timing confirmation; otherwise no stable whole-model speed claim.
confirmation_rule: Freeze adapter, audit source, checkpoint identities and protocol before opening the confirmation seed. Preserve development and every failed run.
scope: Same trained development weights; exact same finite CTMC model; no retraining, heldout task quality, production, GPU or energy claim. Default remains unchanged.
